title: Reinforcement Learning-based Control via Y-wise Affine Neural Networks: Comparative Case Studies for Chemical Processes
summary: In this work we present an efficient and practically implementable approach for the application of reinforcement learning (RL)-based control in chemical process systems. This is an area that has yet to widely adopt RL-based control largely due to inherent challenges in trusting RL algorithms and the time-consuming process of training reliable agents. To address these challenges, we leverage a class of RL algorithms termed Y-wise Affine Neural Network (YANN)- RL, which we have developed in our prior work (Braniff and Tian, 2025a).
